description:
Make the existing GenServer transport an implementation of the Cell behaviour. Goal: zero behaviour change for current consumers; the existing observable contract stays intact, but behind it the Cell protocol is the canonical surface.

## TDD
Tests for Observable.GenServer assert it implements Cell.subscribe / unsubscribe / current correctly. Existing observable tests continue to pass without modification.

## Files
- lib/filament/observable/gen_server.ex (add Cell behaviour)
- test/filament/observable_test.exs (add Cell-protocol assertions)
title: Phase 2.2: Filament.Observable.GenServer implements Cell
